channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Credores acusam Roberta Luchsinger de calote e cobram dívidas
item.description: Creditors file lawsuits against Roberta Luchsinger, a lobbyist and friend of President Lula's son, accusing her of defaulting on old debts. The case raises concerns about political influence and potential irregularities in lobbying activities.

item.title: Contas de Zema em MG têm melhora, mas caixa segue negativo e renúncias disparam
item.description: Zema's administration in Minas Gerais shows improvement in fiscal indicators, but public cash flow remains negative. Budget renunciations surged, while debt renegotiation with the federal government provides temporary relief.

item.title: Governo Lula retoma negociação com Trump e teme que tarifaço se torne permanente
item.description: The Lula government resumes trade negotiations with the US, facing skepticism from PT allies over an agreement's feasibility. Concerns center on tariffs becoming permanent if the deadlock continues.

item.title: Além de Lulinha, Lurian fez lobby no Palácio do Planalto
item.description: Lurian Cordeiro Lula da Silva, daughter of President Lula (PT), is the family member who most frequently visits the Planalto Palace, with 52 records between 2023 and 2025, surpassing even her brother Fábio Luís (Lulinha), who accessed the site 18 times. As a parliamentary advisor to Senator Rogério Carvalho (PT-SE), Lurian has stood out for Sergipe demands and informal interactions with ministers, considered inappropriate by some advisors.

item.title: Julgamento sobre IA de Bolsonaro no TSE deve definir deepfake nas eleições
item.description: The TSE will analyze on September 1st whether the AI-generated video of Bolsonaro during the PL convention constitutes a deepfake, setting rules for AI use in the 2026 elections. The PT federation claims the content promotes early campaigning and political capital transfer. The decision may establish precedents for similar cases.

item.title: Ala da campanha teme TSE e defende jantar de Lula com PIB fora do Alvorada
item.description: Members of Lula's campaign argue that the dinner with bankers and business leaders should take place outside the Palácio do Alvorada to avoid another electoral lawsuit from Flávio Bolsonaro at the TSE. The concern follows Flávio's legal team already filing a lawsuit against Lula over an interview given at the residence. The meeting was arranged amid recent encounters between bankers and Flávio.

item.title: Empresário que criticou "monopólio" do Butantan doa R$ 500 mil a Tarcísio
item.description: Entrepreneur Fernando de Castro Marques, owner of the União Química pharmaceutical group, donated BRL 500,000 to the re-election campaign of Tarcísio de Freitas, representing the largest single donation received so far by this politician. Marques, a close figure to former President Jair Bolsonaro, has previously offered his residence in Brasília for fundraising events and has advocated for private vaccine production in Brazil, criticizing Fiocruz and Butantan for allegedly maintaining a 'monopoly'. His unsuccessful Senate run in 2018 for the Solidarity party underscores his ongoing engagement in Brazilian politics.

item.title: Veja a agenda dos candidatos ao governo de SP nesta segunda (31/8)
item.description: On Monday (August 31), seven candidates for governor of São Paulo carry out campaign activities during the 16th day of the 2026 electoral calendar, with notable figures including Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Fernando Haddad (PT). The front-runners hold events in São Paulo state and its interior, addressing issues such as the economy and privatizations.

item.title: Protagonista da queda de Dilma, Cunha usa o golpe como credencial para tentar voltar à política
item.description: Eduardo Cunha, former Chamber president and key figure in Dilma Rousseff's 2016 impeachment, uses the coup as political capital to return, running for federal deputy in 2026. He claims sole responsibility for the PT's removal and aligns with Flávio Bolsonaro, adopting bolsonarist rhetoric. His narrative reinforces the rise of the Brazilian right post-2016.

item.title: Brasil, una nueva tierra prometida para los cubanos
item.description: Cuban arrivals in Brazil surged starting in 2025, overtaking Venezuelans as the main asylum seekers. Over 90,000 Cuban refugee applications are under review, including 35,000 in the first seven months of 2026. Deteriorating conditions on the Caribbean island have driven this migration wave, particularly via the Amazon route.

item.title: ESPECIAL ELEIÇÕES: o que fazer para resolver o problema da violência? - O Assunto #1794
item.description: A Quaest survey reveals that 33% of voters consider violence their top concern in the 2026 elections, surpassing issues like economy and healthcare. With over 40,000 homicides in 2025, public security becomes a central pillar in the electoral debate, with diverse proposals from candidates to combat organized crime and urban violence.

item.title: 10 anos depois, Brasil não fez mea-culpa e golpe pode se repetir, diz Eugênio Aragão
item.description: Former Minister of Justice Eugênio Aragão states that Brazil has not acknowledged responsibility ten years after Dilma Rousseff's impeachment and warns the coup could repeat. He criticizes the lack of institutional recognition of the impeachment's impact on democracy and highlights the damage to the social state during Temer's government.

item.title: Brasil levaria até 30 anos para compensar jornada menor
item.description: The CNI projects that Brazil would need between 17 and 30 years to accumulate the productivity required to compensate for the reduction of the weekly work schedule from 44 to 40 hours while maintaining jobs and salaries. The study also analyzes alternative scenarios, such as rejection and accommodation, which could lead to a drop in formal jobs or reduction in the wage bill.

item.title: Fim da 6x1 e 'taxa das blusinhas': Congresso deve avançar com pautas de Lula em última semana de votações antes das eleições
item.description: In the final week of congressional voting before the 2026 elections, lawmakers are expected to advance key presidential priorities of Lula, including the PEC to end the 6x1 scale. The government seeks approval of bills before the electoral recess, while the opposition attempts to block progress. Lula meets with the presidents of the Senate and Chamber to push forward agendas such as the electricity sector reform and the new energy tariff social.

item.title: VÍDEO: O que faz o presidente?
item.description: The video explains that in October 2026, Brazilians will elect the next president of the Republic, whose main function is to command the federal Executive Power. Among the president's responsibilities are setting national public policies, choosing ministers, and indicating candidates for positions such as Supreme Court justices and the Attorney General, as well as representing the country abroad and deciding on legislation and the national budget.

item.title: Presidenciáveis criticam emendas parlamentares, mas apostam em propostas genéricas, diz estudo
item.description: A study by Transparency International Brazil reveals that presidential candidates, despite criticizing parliamentary amendments, present generic proposals for reform. Analysis of government plans submitted to the TSE shows focus on vague measures without clear accountability for parliamentarians controlling budgetary resources. The issue is under investigation by the Federal Police and Supreme Court, with over 90 lawmakers under scrutiny for suspected irregularities.

item.title: TSE começa a analisar nesta segunda pedidos de registro de candidaturas à Presidência da República
item.description: The TSE began this Monday analyzing requests for registration of presidential candidacies, including Lula, Alckmin, Zema, Bolsonaro and others. The hearings occur in the virtual plenary and continue until September 2nd. Minister Toffoli postponed the hearing of Renan Santos due to suspected irregularities.

item.title: TSE suspende propaganda de Lula que vincula ‘currículo’ de Flávio Bolsonaro a casos de corrupção
item.description: The TSE suspended a PT advertisement accusing Flávio Bolsonaro of ties to criminal organizations, ruling the piece exceeded permissible political criticism. The decision was preliminary and will be reviewed by the full court. The PL will have a right of reply.

item.title: TSE manda Lula suspender comercial com “currículo” de Flávio
item.description: TSE Minister Estela Aranha suspended Lula's campaign ad criticizing Flávio Bolsonaro's resume, ruling it presented inaccurate information and misled voters. The decision was provisional in a response rights lawsuit and impacts the ad titled 'Know Flávio Bolsonaro's Curriculum'.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro repete que não há irregularidade em patrocínio do Master para filme sobre seu pai
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that the BRL 61 million sponsorship from Banco Master for the Dark Horse film is lawful, contrasting it with Lula's government actions. He emphasized no public funds were used and that justice found no irregularities.

item.title: Vai depender dele, diz Flávio sobre Bolsonaro ser ministro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated that appointing his father Jair Bolsonaro as minister depends on the former president's own will. He also pledged to push for an amnesty, classify criminal factions as terrorist organizations, and appoint Supreme Court justices opposed to abortion and drugs.

item.title: Lula aciona TSE e pede cassação de Flávio Bolsonaro por ato em Barretos
item.description: Lula's campaign filed a lawsuit with the TSE requesting the annulment of Flávio Bolsonaro's ticket over alleged abuse of power at the Barretos roping festival, where the senator is accused of using public and private infrastructure for electoral purposes. The suit also seeks an eight-year ban for running mate Alfredo Gaspar.

item.title: TSE manda suspender propaganda de Lula com 'currículo' de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Minister Estela Aranha of the TSE ordered the suspension of a campaign ad by Lula (PT) that featured a supposed 'resume' of Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The decision prohibits further broadcast of the video until the case is judged. The measure was adopted following analysis of the allegations involving the electoral advertisement.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro repete que perícia não encontrou irregularidade em financiamento de Dark Horse
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, stated in an interview with TV Record that no irregularities were found in the R$61 million sponsorship provided by Daniel Vorcaro, former owner of Banco Master, for the film 'Dark Horse'. He emphasized that the audit did not identify any flaws in the payment. The statement comes amid criticism about potential links between politicians and cultural project funding.

item.title: TSE suspende propaganda de Lula sobre "currículo de Flávio Bolsonaro”
item.description: TSE minister Estela Aranha granted a preliminary injunction to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and suspended a campaign ad from Lula's team featuring Flávio's 'resume', aired during Lula's first electoral program and the Jornal Nacional debate. The ruling took effect on Sunday.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral suspende propaganda eleitoral de Lula que chama Flávio Bolsonaro de 'funcionário fantasma'
item.description: TSE minister Estela Aranha suspended Lula's electoral campaign ad accusing Flávio Bolsonaro of being a 'ghost employee'. The decision is preliminary and will be reviewed by the TSE plenary. Meanwhile, the ad cannot be broadcast on TV.

item.title: TSE suspende propaganda de Lula com 'currículo' de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The TSE minister suspended Lula's ad featuring Flávio Bolsonaro's 'curriculum' after a request from the PL candidate. The decision stemmed from the controversial broadcast during the election campaign.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que não vai permitir intervenção dos EUA no Brasil
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro stated he will not allow U.S. interventions in Brazil under a potential government, limiting cooperation to intelligence agreements and combat against organized crime. He supports classifying groups like Comando Vermelho and PCC as terrorist organizations.

item.title: TSE manda suspender propaganda Lula sobre 'currículo de Flávio' que cita Master e rachadinha
item.description: The Brazilian Electoral Court ordered a preliminary injunction to suspend a PT campaign advertisement discussing Flávio Bolsonaro's curriculum, referencing his Master's degree and the 'rachadinha' controversy. The ruling aims to ensure fair playing time and conditions in the legislative race.

item.title: Homem-aranha do PSol fura Pixuleco e gera briga com 007 do Novo na Paulista
item.description: On Paulista Avenue, a man dressed as Spider-Man destroyed a giant inflatable doll of President Lula (Pixuleco) in an operation by the group Bonde do Arrasa Faixas, led by Junior Freitas, a PSol candidate. The clash involved Carlo Cauti, a Novo candidate known as 007, who accused opponents of assault. Police separated the fight, but accounts of what exactly happened differ among those involved.

item.title: Vazamento de gás provoca incêndio na casa de Kassio Nunes Marques, presidente do TSE
item.description: A gas leak caused a fire at the home of the president of the TSE, Kassio Nunes Marques, in Lago Sul, Brasília. The incident occurred on Sunday and there were no reports of injuries. The exact causes of the gas leak are still under investigation.

item.title: Vazamento de gás provoca incêndio na casa de presidente do TSE, ministro Nunes Marques
item.description: A gas leak from a propane tank connected to an outdoor stove at the home of Supreme Court justice and TSE president Kássio Nunes Marques caused a fire in the upscale Lago Sul neighborhood of Brasília. Firefighters controlled the blaze after 40 minutes, with no injuries reported. The residence sustained significant damage, particularly to its acrylic roof.

item.title: Campanha de Lula pede inelegibilidade de Flávio por ato em Barretos
item.description: Lula's campaign requested the annulment of Flávio Bolsonaro and his running mate's registration for using the Barretos rodeo festival for electoral purposes. The lawsuit accuses them of economic power abuse and indirect donations from prohibited sources, alleging the event was used as a disguised 'showmício'. The Electoral Court was called to investigate potential criminal and electoral offenses.

item.title: Incêndio atinge casa do presidente do TSE, Nunes Marques
item.description: A fire broke out at the residence of the President of the Superior Electoral Court (TSE), Minister Kassio Nunes Marques, caused by a gas leak from an outdoor oven. Firefighters controlled the flames in about 40 minutes, with no injuries reported.

item.title: Missão afirma a Toffoli que decisão sobre candidatura de Renan é “nula”
item.description: The Missão party deemed null the decision by Minister Dias Toffoli to postpone the hearing on Renan Santos' presidential candidacy, arguing the rapporteur cannot examine social media irregularities. Toffoli cited evidence of potential violations in social media profile data without specifying which laws were allegedly broken. Renan responded via video, claiming it's a systemic issue at the TSE affecting all candidates.

item.title: Site do Procon-DF é invadido e exibe mensagem com críticas a Lula
item.description: Hackers invaded the websites of Procon-DF and Jucis-DF, posting criticisms of President Lula's government. Technical teams are working to restore the affected services and investigate the attack.

item.title: Lula convida empresários e banqueiros para jantar após Flávio se reunir com executivos do mercado
item.description: Lula invited business leaders and bankers to a dinner in Brasília, aiming to build ties with sectors wary of both him and Flávio Bolsonaro. The meeting follows presentations of government plans to the financial market, focusing on fiscal adjustment and reducing economic uncertainties.

item.title: Caso reeleito, o que levaria Lula a corrigir o rumo de sua política econômica?
item.description: The economy has become a central issue in the 2026 campaign, with criticisms of Lula for not acknowledging past economic missteps and failing to implement fiscal adjustments. Indicators like public debt exceeding 80% of GDP, mass defaults, and high interest rates pressure for a policy shift, but Lula remains defensive, disregarding warnings from ministers and the market. Right-wing candidates exploit economic weaknesses, while Lula faces the challenge of balancing expansionary policies with fiscal sustainability.

item.title: Votações no Congresso, IA de Bolsonaro no TSE e PIB movimentam a semana
item.description: The National Congress intensifies the voting of bills before the electoral period, focusing on economic, labor and public safety issues. The agenda was set in a meeting between President Lula and the presidents of the Chamber, Hugo Motta, and the Senate, Davi Alcolumbre. The week also includes debates on AI at the TSE and GDP impacts.

item.title: Lula: entre o sonho da vitória no 1º turno e o pesadelo da derrota no 2º
item.description: Lula aims for a first-round victory using electoral ads, Bolsa Família adjustment, and political alliances, but faces a technical tie with Flávio Bolsonaro. The ruling party bets on appealing measures and the useful vote against the far right, though projections suggest the second round favors the opponent.

item.title: Renan Santos nega irregularidades: “Não vamos abaixar a cabeça”
item.description: Presidential candidate Renan Santos (Mission) denied irregularities in the registration of his candidacy after Minister Dias Toffoli removed the process analyzing his slate from the agenda. He stated he will not back down following the court decision and said 'we will not lower our heads' in the face of the news.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro dá ao vice missão de fazer campanha em todos os estados do Nordeste
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, the PL presidential candidate, has tasked his running mate Alfredo Gaspar with campaigning across all nine Northeastern states before the first round on October 4th. The strategy aims to capitalize on the enthusiastic public response during their visit to Maceió and Arapiraca. The Northeast was Lula's strongest region in 2022.

item.title: Moro anuncia “Presídio El Salvador” após encontro com ministro de Bukele
item.description: Sergio Moro (PL) announced, following a meeting with El Salvador's Justice Minister, plans to build a maximum-security prison in Paraná named 'El Salvador Prison' if elected governor. The meeting took place in São Paulo with Flávio Bolsonaro and Central American officials.

item.title: Renan alega "problema interno de sistema" após Toffoli adiar julgamento
item.description: TSE minister Dias Toffoli postponed the ruling on Renan Santos' (Missão) candidacy registration, citing evidence of irregularities in social media profiles. Renan dismissed the decision as an internal system issue already resolved, emphasizing his campaign is the cheapest among major candidates.

item.title: Militância do Missão tem ‘GymRats’ com pontuação em aplicativo e competição de comentários pró-Renan
item.description: Supporters of Renan Santos, from the Mission to the Presidency of the Republic party, organize coordinated actions on social media to increase his digital engagement, including sharing links and critical comments. Despite having 4% voting intention in the latest Datafolha poll, the candidate leads in Instagram follower growth among competitors, with 2.4 million followers and highly viewed videos. The strategy involves WhatsApp groups and encouragement of active participation in the candidate's posts on X (formerly Twitter).

item.title: Renan Santos nega irregularidades após Tofolli citar 'indícios de ilicitude' em candidatura: 'Não vamos baixar a cabeça'
item.description: Renan Santos (Missão) denied irregularities after TSE minister Dias Toffoli identified 'evidence of illegality' in his presidential nomination, related to the initial failure to detail 18 social media profiles. In a video on social media, Renan stated they will not 'lower their heads' and defended the campaign as the poorest among major candidates, using only private donations and crowdfunding. Toffoli decided to remove the process from the agenda to allow analysis of the new declaration and time for the candidate's defense.

item.title: João Moreira Salles apresenta ‘masterclass’ em festival de documentários
item.description: The 6th edition of Citronela Doc, a documentary festival in Ilhabela, introduced competitive showcases and a masterclass by João Moreira Salles. The event featured films on cultural and political themes and offered online programming nationwide.

item.title: O risco Bolsonaro 2.0?
item.description: A Flávio Bolsonaro victory in 2026 would raise alarms about democratic risks, yet Brazilian institutions such as Congress, the Judiciary, and the Public Ministry have resilience. Despite external backing from Trump, multipartisanship and institutional legacy hinder swift authoritarian erosion.

item.title: Governo Lula vai prever aporte de R$ 652 milhões na Eletronuclear no Orçamento de 2027
item.description: The Lula administration plans to allocate R$651.8 million to Eletronuclear in the 2027 budget, according to sources cited by Folha. The funding aims to support the nuclear plant's operations and ensure national energy security.

item.title: Ato na Paulista termina em confusão, agressões e Pixuleco de Lula destruído
item.description: Political rally on Paulista Avenue ended in chaos with clashes between left-wing and right-wing groups, resulting in assaults and the destruction of a Lula puppet. The incident was reported to the police, increasing tensions in the 2026 electoral scenario.
